title: Dance All Night
author: Rick Mohr
problems: Row 5 "partner pull by right, grand right left halfway" can't start from where the dancers are: Each change of a grand right and left takes two beats.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing, face the next · swing-out" can't start from where the dancers are: The eight cannot reach those places as couples.
The progression after row 7 "partners balance & swing, face the next · swing-out" doesn't work out: Couple 1 has no neighbors in the middle of the set.
Row 2 "first corners swing, square sets" can't start from where the dancers are: Everyone needs a partner beside them.
Row 4 "first corners allemande left 1¼" can't start from where the dancers are: Everyone needs a partner beside them.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
